policy: An obligation closes only with the acceptance evidence named in its record. Draft text, a local hash, a narrow test, or silence does not close an empirical, review, governance, license, or disclosure obligation.

obligations.title: Resolve and approve the ACBE-P5 naming convention
obligations.acceptance_evidence: Authorized registry decision preserving ACBE_legacy, ACBE_NT2, ACBE-P5, and ACA as distinct types, with no unsupported acronym expansion.
obligations.failure_effect: Keep title and notation DRAFT; prohibit legacy causal reinterpretation.

obligations.acceptance_evidence: Attributable line-by-line review of metric conventions, measurable pushforwards, domain compatibility, composition, estimand constants, and collision bound, with all corrections merged.
obligations.failure_effect: Retain propositions as proof-sketch candidates.

obligations.title: Formalize the finite/measure-theoretic core
obligations.acceptance_evidence: Reproducible proof artifact or executable finite verifier covering definitions, composition, estimand bound, collision bound, and counterexamples with an axiom audit.
obligations.failure_effect: No machine-checked or verified-extension wording.

obligations.title: Choose outcome space, metric, tolerance, and error budget
obligations.acceptance_evidence: Prospective rationale for the outcome space, total variation or alternative discrepancy, epsilon, mean/tail/worst-case thresholds, and metric-specific composition conditions.
obligations.failure_effect: No approximate-abstraction test can be preregistered.

obligations.title: Register one exact Paper 5 empirical claim
obligations.acceptance_evidence: Authorized canonical claim-ledger record containing exact claim text, scope, controls, falsifier, uncertainty, Ring 4, NOT LICENSED, and HELD status.
obligations.failure_effect: Harness v2 preregistration cannot bind a qualifying claim.

obligations.title: Freeze the low- and high-level causal models
obligations.acceptance_evidence: Versioned interventional profiles specifying contexts, state spaces, intervention operators, solution/execution semantics, and every allowed intervention.
obligations.failure_effect: Causal target remains undefined.

obligations.title: Freeze tau, kappa, omega, and the required evaluation domain
obligations.acceptance_evidence: Content-addressed map artifacts, derivation record, training/discovery boundary, intervention-collision audit, support audit, and complete E table frozen before confirmatory outcome access.
obligations.failure_effect: Any subsequent result is exploratory only.

obligations.title: Classify causal identification for every estimand
obligations.acceptance_evidence: For each estimand, a DIRECT_INTERVENTIONAL, ASSUMPTION_IDENTIFIED, PARTIALLY_IDENTIFIED, NOT_IDENTIFIED, or SIMULATION_ONLY decision with exact assumptions and derivation.

obligations.title: Operationalize non-vacuity and support gates
obligations.acceptance_evidence: Prospective retention score, minimum intervention discrimination, collision limit, coverage floor, support/extrapolation rule, and failure consequences.
obligations.failure_effect: A low defect cannot be described as a meaningful abstraction.

obligations.title: Freeze negative and adversarial controls
obligations.acceptance_evidence: Exact zero, sham, same-norm random, orthogonal/null, wrong-layer, wrong-token, label-shuffle, matched-taxonomy, negative-outcome, permutation, and replication controls with thresholds and falsifiers, or a documented reason each inapplicable control is omitted.

obligations.title: Complete power, uncertainty, and multiplicity plan
obligations.acceptance_evidence: Exact power-analysis artifact, sampling/group floors, interval method, clustered dependence treatment, multiplicity correction, missing/exclusion maxima, and fixed stopping rule.
obligations.failure_effect: No confirmatory run is eligible.
